notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
Thank you for making Exterminator a success! Because we love you so much, we decided to roll out an update just in time for summer.

Here's what you have to look forward to:

Update Overview
Summer Sale 50% (During sale dates)
Cloud Saving
13 New Achievements
New Gimmicks
Bug Fixes

That is all for today! For any questions, feedback, or anything else, please feel free to comment to this post, or write a new thread in the forums. Once again, thank you for all the support, and we hope you will enjoy the update!
